snippet.title: Architect Life: A House Design Simulator | Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Preorder now: https://www.xbox.com/en-us/games/store/architect-life-a-house-design-simulator/9pdmgw2d5250

Step into the world of Architect Life: A House Design Simulator, a creative and immersive experience where you become a modern-day architect balancing design and functionality.

 Design, renovate, and customize unique homes based on your clients' needs. Select materials, optimize space, and bring your architectural visions to life.

 Use intuitive tools and a wide range of customization options to express your style and grow your career filled with challenges.

 Launching on June 19, 2025 on Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 5 and PC.
